about.heading: Building scalable infrastructure, automating delivery, and monitoring modern cloud environments.
about.description:
I’m Lasya Mandapati, a Computer Science & Engineering graduate and aspiring DevOps & Cloud Engineer with hands-on training in cloud infrastructure, automation, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and monitoring.

I’ve worked with technologies including AWS, Azure, GCP, Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, and cloud security tools through practical learning and project implementations.

I’m looking to begin my career in a Cloud or DevOps role where I can apply my skills, solve real-world infrastructure challenges, and continue growing as an engineer.
